blocks.prompt: 9. \(A(-2, -1)\) and \(B(3, 4)\) are two points on the solar panel roof. Find slope and tilt angle.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh asal zindagi ka slope wala sawal hai: solar panel wali chhat ki line do points se guzarti hai.
Diya kya hai? Do points \(A\) aur \(B\). Find kya karna hai? Slope aur tilt angle (jhukao ka angle).
Slope = 'rise over run', yani upar kitna gaye ko aage kitna gaye se divide karna.
Tilt angle woh angle hai jo chhat ki line horizontal (\(x\)-axis) se banati hai, aur us ka tan slope ke barabar hota hai.
Plan: pehle slope formula, phir \(\tan^{-1}\).
steps:
Diya gaya: chhat ki line par \(A(-2, -1)\) aur \(B(3, 4)\).
Maloom karna: slope \(m\) aur tilt angle \(\theta\).
Tareeqa: \(m = \dfrac{y_{2} - y_{1}}{x_{2} - x_{1}}\), aur line ka inclination \(\tan\theta = m\) se. Solar panel ka jhukao isi angle se tay hota hai, taa ke dhoop seedhi pare.

Slope
\[m = \dfrac{4 - (-1)}{3 - (-2)} = \dfrac{5}{5} = 1\]
Kyun: negative ko minus karna jama karna hai: \(4 + 1 = 5\) aur \(3 + 2 = 5\).
Dhyan dein: upar \(y\) ka farq aur neeche \(x\) ka farq, aur dono mein ek hi point pehle.

Tilt angle
\[\tan\theta = 1\]
\[\theta = \tan^{-1}(1) = 45^{\circ}\]
Kyun: line ka slope us ke positive \(x\)-axis ke saath angle ka tan hota hai, aur \(\tan 45^{\circ} = 1\) to zabani yaad hai.

Tasdeeq:
\[\text{rise} = 5,\quad \text{run} = 5\]
Kyun: upar aur aage barabar chalein to isosceles right triangle banta hai, jis ke dono acute angles \(45^{\circ}\) hote hain \(\checkmark\). Yani chhat bilkul aadhe right angle par jhuki hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Yahan answer key ki numbering khisak gayi hai: is sawal ka jawab number 10 par ('1, \(45^{\circ}\)') chhapa hai, jo sahi hai. Number 9 par '\(x - y + 100 = 0\), slope \(= 1\)' likha hai jo Exercise 5.3 ke kisi sawal se match nahi karta; use nazar-andaz kijiye.
